question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"though."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Though (किसी बात के बावजूद; यद्यपि, हालाँकि)"** is used as a conjunction to introduce a subordinate clause that contrasts with the main clause.

 
 
• **Example**: *"**Though__** it was raining, she went for a run." *(Contrasting subordinate clause) -
 
 
 
• Here, the sentence is talking about two contrasting ideas (my brother's compliment and it was backhanded).
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

Correct passage:

I was surprised __first__ at the news that my father spared me any thought, and second at my brother's compliment, __**though**__ it was backhanded. Dhri ______ (3) ______ commented on my looks; nor did he encourage me to comment on his. Such useless ______ (4) ______, he believed, made people vain. Was this another ______ (5) ______ of change? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Afterwards (बाद में, पश्‍चात)"**** **means "later" and is used to refer to a time after a particular event or action.
 
• **"All (समस्‍त, समूचा, सारा)"**** **means "every one" or "the whole quantity" and is used as a determiner or pronoun.
 
• **"Through ((किसी वस्‍तु के) इस पार से उस पार; आर-पार)"** means "moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location)" or "by means of (a process or method)". It can also mean "completed" or "finished".
